issues.claim: Opening line: "a Manasquan-based John B. Wright division announced in 2021"
issues.problem: Minor wording only. The cited 2021 press release describes a partnership/merger ("partnered with", "Greg has decided to join us", offices in Jamesburg, Shrewsbury and Manasquan, John B. Wright continuing under its own name and team); it never uses the word "division", and johnbwright.com does not describe itself as a Soden division. The underlying facts (Manasquan agency, 2021, now part of the Soden group) are supported.
issues.fix: Reword to "the John B. Wright agency in Manasquan, which partnered with Soden in 2021" or "partner agency"; no change to numbers or claims required.
